module_summary: Synchronous FIFO with valid/ready push and pop ports: an 8-entry register array addressed by wrapping write/read pointers, with an occupancy counter deriving full/empty and a synchronous flush.

anchors.name: n8_2f0
anchors.why: 8-entry data array written at write pointer, read asynchronously at read pointer.

anchors.name: n7_951
anchors.why: Push valid; with not-full it writes the array and advances write pointer.

anchors.name: n9_9bd
anchors.why: Write data stored into the array on accepted push.

anchors.name: n6_b9f
anchors.why: Pop-side valid, asserted when occupancy is nonzero.

anchors.name: n12_02a
anchors.why: Read data, array entry at the read pointer.

anchors.name: n10_f0b
anchors.why: Push ready, asserted when FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: n2_89c
anchors.why: Pop ready from consumer; with valid it advances read pointer.

anchors.name: n14_73c
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing the array, incremented on accepted push.

anchors.name: n18_b96
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting output entry, incremented on accepted pop.

anchors.name: n13_4b9
anchors.why: Occupancy count; drives full/empty and the count output.

anchors.name: n16_eee
anchors.why: Synchronous flush clearing both pointers and the occupancy count.

anchors.name: n1_8f0
anchors.why: Accepted push: array write enable and write pointer/count increment.

anchors.name: n3_d42
anchors.why: Accepted pop: read pointer increment and count decrement.

groups.name: pointer_control
groups.description: Write/read pointers, occupancy counter, push/pop enables and flush.
